svg.text: Hand-picked: Default's hues kept, each at about 0.62 of its saturation, lightness drawn toward the middle, so nothing
Each ring is a Default color, each dot the palette's; the arrows are the moves between, in order:
HUE AND COLORFULNESS: angle is hue, distance out is chroma
Authored: a soft, barely warm charcoal, its light ramp a step lower in contrast.
